name: Lipid Profile
instructions: Fast for 8-12 hours; water is permitted unless otherwise instructed.

name: Fasting Plasma Glucose
instructions: Fast for 8-10 hours; water is permitted.

name: Postprandial Plasma Glucose
instructions: Collect the sample 2 hours after the start of the meal unless the clinician specifies otherwise.

name: Liver Function Test Without Proteins
instructions: Fasting is preferred when performed with other metabolic tests.

name: Liver Function Test With Proteins
instructions: Fasting is preferred when performed with other metabolic or lipid tests.

name: Liver Function Test
instructions: Fasting is preferred when performed with other metabolic or lipid tests.

name: Renal Function Test
instructions: Follow clinician instructions regarding hydration and medicines.

name: Thyroid Profile
instructions: For patients taking thyroid medicine, collect before the daily dose when clinically requested.

name: Iron Profile
instructions: Morning fasting collection is preferred; collect before iron supplementation when clinically appropriate.

name: Prothrombin Time and INR
instructions: Record anticoagulant medicine and last dose time.

name: Dengue NS1 Antigen, IgM and IgG
instructions: Interpret in relation to day of illness and clinical findings.
